citations.quote:
[name="雅儿"]恩希欧迪斯老爷，请当心脚下。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_cardoorc", volume=1)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_267_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_267_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="切斯特"]恩希欧迪斯，我把车开过来了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_172_svrash_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]谢谢你，叔父。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_cardoorc", volume=1)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement", volume=0.6)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_267_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="切斯特"]要回宅邸吗？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[name="诺希斯"]回……总部……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_267_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="切斯特"]恩希欧迪斯？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_172_svrash_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]听他的吧，我也正好还有一些杂务需要处理。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_174_slbell_1#11$1",duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_174_slbell_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="恩雅"]切斯特叔叔，许久不见。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_267_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="切斯特"]圣女大人。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_174_slbell_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="恩雅"]这种时候，叫我的名字就好了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_267_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="切斯特"]……恩雅，看到你平安无事，叔叔就放心了。
